item.title: Arc’teryx Bolsters Executive Team With Fashion Appointments
item.description: Former Tommy Hilfiger executive Avery Baker joins as the North Vancouver-based company's first chief brand officer, and Tobia Prevedello, formerly of Celine (LVMH), joins as general manager of EMEA.

item.title: Former Converse President and CEO to Lead Tracksmith
item.description: Jared Carver appointed Chief Executive Officer; Founder Matt Taylor transitions to role as Chief Creative Officer.

item.title: Rumpl Appoints James Atkin as Vice President of Marketing
item.description: Former NOMATIC executive to lead Rumpl’s next phase of expansion.

item.title: Media Showroom at Outdoor Market Alliance Set for 8th Successive Event
item.description: Hub for outdoor business in Colorado celebrates fourth year of being a venue for more than 1,500 media-brand meetings.

item.title: PAKA Releases 2025 Impact Report
item.description: The 2025 report highlights how PAKA brings people closer to the source.

item.title: The North Face and Vans Parent Reports Revenue Growth, Driven by Americas
item.description: A strong holiday season, ecommerce and Americas drove better-than-expected results at VF Corp. TNF and Timberland reported growth while Vans' turnaround is still in progress.

item.title: Columbia Sportswear Targets Super Bowl Fans with Bear Poop Beer
item.description: The beer, aimed to bring "a taste of the outdoors" to sports fans stuck inside, is part of Columbia's head-turning new marketing strategy.

item.title: On Announces Appointment of New Chief Financial Officer

item.title: Boot Barn Celebrates Return to Huntington Beach with New Store
item.description: Boot Barn’s return to Huntington Beach arrives alongside several new store openings across the nation throughout January.

item.title: HOKA Introduces Cielo X1 3.0
item.description: Cielo X1 3.0 is the brand’s lightest super shoe to date, engineered to minimize weight and maximize performance.
